notes: ACCESS: HTTP-first tier (a) worked throughout - curl_cffi impersonate=chrome110 against www.quince.com, no block encountered; robots.txt allows all fetch tiers (only account/checkout paths disallowed). TREE: built from union of mega-menu (siteData.menuPrimary -> 'Home' item's submenu columns, extracted from __NEXT_DATA__ on homepage) + sitemap_shop.xml/sitemap_subcollections.xml + each category page's own FILTER_AND_SORT 'subcollections' facet (used as the sub-category strip). Where a parent page exposed a subcollections facet, drilled into each child's own dedicated canonical URL/page rather than recording the parent (parent-URL rule). QTY: taken from the FILTER_AND_SORT widget's 'total' field (matches the rendered product-count) on each leaf's own canonical page in __NEXT_DATA__ -> props.pageProps.pageData.context.pageDataJson.widgets; verified title/canonical matched the requested node on every leaf. EXCLUDED and why: Furniture (Living/Bedroom/Dining/Outdoor furniture, named furniture collections e.g. 'The Sierra Collection'), Lighting, Kitchen & Dining (cookware, dinnerware, glassware, flatware, kitchen electrics), Home Decor non-textile (Wall Art, Planters, Decorative Objects, Mirrors, Coffee Table Books, Candles/Diffusers), Travel/Luggage (suitcases, duffles, backpacks, garment bags - personal-carrying items per Textile/Storage boundary rules, not home storage), Baby & Kids apparel and Nursery furniture, Gourmet Food & Wine, Pets, Beauty & Wellness. Excluded 'Silk Accessories' under Robes (11 items - inspected product list, dominated by beauty/personal items like a silk sleep mask, not home textile) and 'Dryer Balls' under Robes (laundry accessory, not fabric/textile or a storage container). Excluded 'Bathroom Accessories' (3 items - inspected product list: 1 decorative accessories set + 1 rattan hamper; too mixed/small to call primary-storage). Excluded 'Rug Pads' (2 items - functional under-rug padding, not itself a floor textile). Excluded material-based cross-category hub pages (/shop/home/linen, /shop/home/percale, /shop/home/sateen, /shop/home/flannel, /shop/home/silk-bedding, /shop/home/bamboo/*, /shop/home/organic-airy-gauze, /shop/home/bedding-by-fabric, /shop/home/patterns) and legacy/alias URLs (/shop/home/organic-plush-towels, /shop/home/napkins, /shop/home/placemats, /shop/home/runners, /shop/home/all-bath/bath-towels-bundles, /shop/home/all-bath/luxury-robes, style-based rug URLs like /shop/home/shag-rugs, /shop/home/persian-rugs) since these duplicate products already counted under their primary type-based category page and are not in the current header mega-menu or sitemap_subcollections.xml. Excluded all 'Shop All'/View All/Collection/ promotional pages (all-decor, all-bath, rugs-and-curtains, bedding/bundle-and-save, back-to-campus, premium-brands, style-your-sanctuary, etc). For STORAGE: only one genuine Storage category found on the whole site, 'Storage & Organization' (/shop/home/boxes-and-storage, qty 18); no closet/wardrobe/laundry/office/kitchen-pantry storage categories exist elsewhere in the nav or sitemap - wardrobes/dressers are handled under Furniture, not Storage, per the site's own hierarchy.
